rec.name: Product Teaser Texts (Metafield-driven subtitle under product title)
rec.status: Built — launched (tested internally; documented in Slite; product image added to the product catalog)

what.text: A short, product-specific teaser line shown directly below the product title. It appears on the PDP and in every product card or product list on the home page and collection pages. Content comes from a product metafield called 'Teaser-Texte' (rich text, so single words can be bolded). Font size (desktop and mobile) and text colour are set globally in the theme settings, and display can be switched on or off separately for home, collection and product pages. On product-list cards the teaser is a link to the product page.

why.text: The teaser puts a single benefit, USP or emotional hook right next to the product name, where attention is highest. This helps shoppers decide before they open the PDP and reinforces the value proposition on the PDP. Bolding single words lets key terms stand out when the text is skimmed. Because each product has its own text, the copy stays relevant instead of generic.

how.text: 1) Create a product metafield 'Teaser-Texte' (rich text) in the Shopify admin. Its definition namespace must match the lookup used in the code (product.metafields.standard['teaser-texte']). 2) Create the snippet teaser-text.liquid. It decides from the template (index / collection / product) and the theme settings whether to show the text. It outputs the metafield with metafield_tag, as a div on the PDP and as a link to product.url in lists. It also injects CSS using the colour and font-size settings, with a media query at 1000px for desktop. 3) Add a 'Teaser texte' group to config/settings_schema.json with: desktop font size range, mobile font size range, colour picker, and three checkboxes (home, collection, PDP). 4) Render the snippet under the product title in product-item.liquid with product_page: false, and in product-info.liquid with product_page: true. 5) Merchants write the text in Admin > Products > [product] > Metafields section > 'Teaser-Texte'.

dependencies.text: Requires a product metafield 'Teaser-Texte' (rich text) and edits to theme files (new snippet, settings_schema.json, product-item.liquid, product-info.liquid). Needs a developer, because non-devs cannot install it. The code assumes a theme with these two files and a 'product.metafields.standard' namespace. Note that the code uses the class name 'product-teasure-text' (typo) and that the CSS is output inline each time the snippet renders. Merchants need guidance on where to find the metafield: it is in the Metafields block at the bottom of the product page in the admin.
